definitions.units: abundances and K in copies per cell; guide_total_M in loaded-guide copies per cell
definitions._comment_identical_background: background_sites and reporter are held IDENTICAL across systems so guide_total_M is the SOLE differentiator. A per-system MEASURED background (real endogenous target pools and Kd per cell type) is a documented refinement (Prompt 3).
definitions._comment_verify: Every numeric value is an object {value, verify}. The verify string is a VERIFY note to confirm against the primary source; load_systems RAISES if value or verify is missing.
